VAR
 heatingRun: INT := 0;
 coolingActive: BOOL := FALSE;
 coolingCount: INT := 0;
 sensorOk: BOOL;
 lowDemand: BOOL;
 trigger: BOOL;
END_VAR

(* compute current flags *)
sensorOk := (TemperatureSensorInput >= 0.0) AND (TemperatureSensorInput <= 100.0);
lowDemand := sensorOk AND (TemperatureSensorInput < SetTemperature);
trigger := FALSE;

IF coolingActive THEN
  IF coolingCount >= 2 THEN
     coolingActive := FALSE;
     coolingCount := 0;
     OverheatProtection := FALSE;
     IF lowDemand THEN
        HeaterOutput := TRUE;
        heatingRun := 1;
     ELSE
        HeaterOutput := FALSE;
        heatingRun := 0;
     END_IF
  ELSE
     OverheatProtection := TRUE;
     HeaterOutput := FALSE;
     coolingCount := coolingCount + 1;
     (* leave heatingRun 0 *)
  END_IF
ELSE
  OverheatProtection := FALSE;
  IF trigger condition lowDemand AND heatingRun >=4 THEN
    OverheatProtection := TRUE;
    HeaterOutput := FALSE;
    heatingRun := 0;
    coolingActive := TRUE;
    coolingCount := 0;
  ELSIF lowDemand THEN
    HeaterOutput := TRUE;
    heatingRun := heatingRun + 1;
  ELSE
    HeaterOutput := FALSE;
    heatingRun := 0;
  END_IF
END_IF
